subject: Renewal + Capacity Add-on: invoice split & PO mapping for Acme Retail
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + Capacity Add-on: invoice split & PO mapping for Acme Retail

Hi Lena —

Great to talk yesterday. As we move forward on the renewal and the +250K token capacity add-on, procurement asked for a couple billing items so accounting can process the PO and get us on the new term sooner. Quick summary and asks: 

- Acme wants invoices split between Acme Retail US (entity: Acme Retail, EIN 12-3456789) and Acme Holdings EU (VAT ID pending). Can Redwood issue separate invoices per legal entity?
- We have one PO already for the US entity (PO# ACME-US-789) — please confirm that maps to the renewal + add-on.
- For the EU entity we need a separate PO and the VAT treatment (reverse-charge vs. Redwood VAT registration). Can you share the EU billing entity name + VAT ID if you have it?
- Net terms: your procurement asked for Net60. Our standard renewal terms are Net45; Marissa can confirm an exception if we need to bridge to Net60. Any flexibility on Net45?

If you can share the PO file(s) and the accounts-payable contact, we’ll loop in Finance and send the signed amendment + W-9 for your records. I can also kick off a split-invoice workflow once we have the EU PO.

Attachments: none on this message — I’ll follow up with documents once Jordan gives the go-ahead.

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + Capacity Add-on: invoice split & PO mapping for Acme Retail

Thanks, Soojin. Quick responses below and attaching the US PO.

- Yes — we require separate invoices per legal entity. I attached PO_ACME_US_789.pdf which covers the US renewal + add-on.
- We will generate a separate PO for the EU entity (Acme Holdings Europe Ltd). I'll get that to you by EOD Friday.
- VAT: Acme Holdings Europe is VAT-registered in Ireland (IE1234567V). We expect reverse-charge where applicable; please confirm Redwood's VAT handling for EU invoices or if you need to register.
- Net terms: Procurement prefers Net60 but will accept Net45 if the amendment can be signed and the first invoice processed this billing cycle.

Accounts-payable is cc'd — AP, please confirm the billing email and any required invoice fields (PO number, remit-to, tax id).

Attaching: PO_ACME_US_789.pdf

Best,
Lena Torres
Senior Procurement Manager | Acme Retail

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Renewal + Capacity Add-on: invoice split & PO mapping for Acme Retail

Looping in Finance guidance. Notes: 

- We can issue separate invoices per legal entity. For US entity we require EIN and PO (we have ACME-US-789 as attached). For EU entity we need legal name, VAT ID (Lena provided IE1234567V), and the EU billing address.
- Tax docs: send W-9 (US) for Redwood for the US invoice. For EU, since Acme is VAT-registered and expects reverse-charge, we should include an invoice note indicating VAT reverse-charge and include Acme's VAT ID on the invoice. No Redwood VAT registration required for reverse-charge, unless Acme requests otherwise.
- Net terms: standard is Net45. Given this is a renewal + expansion and procurement is okay to sign the amendment, we can accept Net45 for the US PO if the signed amendment is returned within 48 hours. If they need Net60, we need explicit approval from RevOps; that will add ~2 business days. 

Action items for Soojin/Marissa: 
1) Provide W-9 (attached) and send the signed amendment via DocuSign to accounts-payable.
2) For EU invoice: confirm Acme Holdings Europe's billing address and whether they want invoices in EUR or USD. If EUR, we need the currency field on the amendment.

I attached a template amendment (redline accepted) — when signed Finance will push invoices to AP with PO mapping and notes.

Jordan Blake
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
